critical_code_review_comments: ChecklistsTab.toggleActive PATCHes the entire ChecklistIn object (spread ...c) which is fine but sends server-generated fields (id, created_by_id, created_at) back to the server; harmless because backend Pydantic model ignores unknown fields, but cleaner to send only {active: !c.active} like TodosTab.toggle does.
TodosTab canEdit allows creator to edit others' todos including reassigning owner_id — confirm this matches product intent (currently unrestricted for admins/creator/owner).
